description: This file implements a JSON-over-Unix socket communication wrapper, defining a structure for sending and receiving JSON objects over Unix domain sockets with thread-safe methods.

classes.name: JSONUnix
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around a Unix domain socket connection that allows sending and receiving JSON objects.

methods.name: NewJSONUnix
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a JSONUnix object from a net.UnixConn.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON and sends it over the Unix socket connection, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives data from the Unix socket, deserializes JSON into the provided value.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the Unix socket connection ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: getNextMsgLen
methods.description: Peek at the socket to determine the length of the next message.
